name: Kota

queries.query: कोटा राजस्थान शहरी GIS भू नक्शा खसरा नक्शा आधिकारिक
queries.scope: Find an anonymous official Kota parcel map and full vector endpoint.
queries.result: Rajasthan’s public Urban GIS portal exposes city/ULB, Khasra/plot, and jurisdiction layer selectors with coordinate and Khasra search. Its disclaimer says viewing only and attributes the data to Settlement Department Khasra/village boundaries; no anonymous full-geometry response was confirmed.
queries.executionMethod: Official source search and read-only service inspection.

queries.query: Kota Rajasthan official urban GIS cadastral parcel Khasra plot map public vector
queries.scope: Cross-check Kota portal ownership and whether its map exposes downloadable geometry.
queries.result: The public portal provides a visual map interface and Khasra/plot layer selection, but full parcel geometry/vector access and city-specific WUP-point response remain unverified. The municipal page links a jurisdiction-boundary map, not parcel polygons.
queries.executionMethod: Official source search and read-only service inspection.
